title: Turmeric Milk for Immunity
description: A traditional Ayurvedic remedy that helps boost immunity and reduce inflammation.
preparation: Heat a cup of milk, add 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric, a pinch of black pepper, and mix well. Add honey if desired.
usageInstructions: Drink warm before bedtime for best results.

title: Ginger Tea for Digestion
description: Ginger tea is a natural remedy for indigestion, bloating, and nausea.
preparation: Boil water, add grated ginger, let it steep for 5 minutes, then strain. Add honey and lemon juice.
usageInstructions: Drink after meals to aid digestion.
precautions: Not recommended for people on blood thinners

title: Amla Juice for Hair Growth
description: Amla (Indian Gooseberry) is rich in Vitamin C and promotes healthy hair growth.
preparation: Blend fresh amla with water, strain the juice, and add honey for taste.
usageInstructions: Drink on an empty stomach for best results.

title: Tulsi Tea for Cough & Cold
description: Tulsi (Holy Basil) tea is an excellent remedy for colds, flu, and respiratory issues.
preparation: Boil tulsi leaves in water, add grated ginger, strain, and add honey.
usageInstructions: Drink twice a day to relieve cough and cold.

title: Neem Paste for Acne
description: Neem has antibacterial properties that help treat acne and skin infections.
preparation: Grind neem leaves with water to make a paste, add a pinch of turmeric.
usageInstructions: Apply to affected areas and leave for 15 minutes before washing off.

title: Triphala Powder for Detox
description: Triphala is a powerful Ayurvedic remedy for detoxifying the body and improving digestion.
preparation: Mix 1 teaspoon of Triphala powder in warm water, add honey for taste.
usageInstructions: Drink before bedtime for best results.
precautions: May cause diarrhea in high doses

title: Ashwagandha for Stress Relief
description: Ashwagandha is an adaptogen that helps manage stress and anxiety.
preparation: Mix 1 teaspoon of Ashwagandha powder in warm milk, add honey if desired.

title: Clove Oil for Toothache
description: Clove oil is a natural pain reliever for toothaches and gum infections.
preparation: Dip a cotton ball in clove oil.
usageInstructions: Apply to the affected tooth for instant relief.

title: Fennel Seeds for Digestion
description: Fennel seeds help relieve bloating, indigestion, and gas.
preparation: Chew fennel seeds or steep in hot water to make tea.
usageInstructions: Drink after meals for better digestion.

title: Aloe Vera Gel for Skin Hydration
description: Aloe Vera is a natural moisturizer that soothes dry and irritated skin.
preparation: Extract fresh Aloe Vera gel from the leaf.
usageInstructions: Apply directly to the skin and leave it on.
